description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling VariantVal data structures, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion, used within the Spark framework.

classes.name: VariantUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing constants and methods for handling VariantVal binary data, including type info, conversion, and parsing.

classes.name: VariantBuilder
classes.description: A class for constructing VariantVal binary data from JSON strings, managing internal buffers and encoding logic.

classes.name: FieldEntry
classes.description: A NamedTuple representing metadata about object fields in VariantVal, including key, id, and offset.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts VariantVal binary data to a JSON string, considering timezone for timestamp fields.

methods.name: to_python
methods.description: Converts VariantVal binary data to a nested Python data structure.

methods.name: parse_json
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into VariantVal binary data (value and metadata).
